address: 11 Lane 394, Section 1, Wenhua 3rd Road, Linkou District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The spacious, cheerful room is named after the Taiwanese transliteration of Linkou, where it is located. Seafood from the Penghu archipelago is the main event, alongside premium imported fish and crab. Make your pick from the live fish tank and ask the staff for the best ways to prepare them. Steamed garlic prawns on glass noodles stand out with bouncy meat and deep flavour. There are also set menus for parties ranging from 2 to 10 people.
